name: Robert Garcia
source: Robert is by all means Ryo's polar opposite, despite their deep friendship. Fashionable, intelligent, rich and above all else a talented fighter. He seems perfect at first glance with his endless charisma and ability to work his way through everything, but he may act cocky and self-assured at times. Despite this, Robert has a heart rife with good and justice, and will not hesitate to come to the aid of his loved ones.
